posts.text:
Chai Junction is excited to announce the launch of our Winter Menu, available across all Lahore branches from December 1st.

As the temperature drops, we believe great conversations deserve even better beverages. Our new winter lineup includes carefully crafted hot drinks designed for the students, professionals, and families who make Lahore's winters memorable.

This weekend, visit any Chai Junction branch to be among the first to experience our winter collection. We look forward to warming up your season, one cup at a time.

#ChaiJunction #WinterMenu #Lahore #FoodAndBeverage
